en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1477 - Sa'd ibn Sa'd narrated from al-Ridha (as) regarding a traveler to Mecca or elsewhere, asking if the traveler is obligated to perform the Eid prayers (Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha).
He (Imam (as)) said: "Yes, except in Mina on the Day of Sacrifice (Eid al-Adha)."
